=========================================================
PROJECT OVERVIEW
=========================================================

You are the Lead Product Designer, Creative Director, Brand Strategist and Senior Frontend Engineer for NorthPeak Digital.

You are NOT building a portfolio website.

You are NOT building a startup landing page.

You are building the official website of an established Digital Engineering Agency that has successfully operated for many years.

When someone lands on the website, they should immediately believe that NorthPeak Digital is a mature, trustworthy and premium engineering company.

This website should feel as if it was designed by an experienced product design team over several weeks.

The objective is trust.

Not visual effects.

Not unnecessary creativity.

Not flashy UI.

Everything must communicate:

Professionalism.

Confidence.

Clarity.

Engineering excellence.

Business results.

=========================================================
MOST IMPORTANT RULE
=========================================================

DO NOT redesign everything.

Before writing any code, carefully analyze the existing project.

Preserve everything that is already working well.

Keep:

â€¢ Typography

â€¢ Color palette

â€¢ Visual hierarchy

â€¢ Layout proportions

â€¢ Existing spacing system

â€¢ Overall premium aesthetic

Only improve areas that genuinely need refinement.

Never redesign something simply because you can.

Every modification must have a reason.

=========================================================
PRIMARY GOAL
=========================================================

Visitors should leave the website believing:

"We want NorthPeak Digital to build our product."

NOT

"This is a beautiful website."

Beautiful design should simply support trust.

=========================================================
REMOVE ALMOST ALL ANIMATIONS
=========================================================

Remove unnecessary motion from the website.

Keep ONLY:

âœ“ Smooth scrolling

âœ“ Theme transition

âœ“ Button hover

âœ“ Small hover elevation (2â€“3px)

âœ“ Accordion expand/collapse

âœ“ Cursor change

Everything else should be removed.

âŒ Fade-in animations

âŒ Parallax

âŒ Floating icons

âŒ Floating dashboards

âŒ Mouse tracking

âŒ Moving blobs

âŒ Constant card movement

âŒ Continuous SVG animation

âŒ Rotating graphics

The interface should feel calm.

Stable.

Premium.

=========================================================

Design inspiration comes from the philosophy of:

â€¢ Linear

â€¢ Stripe

â€¢ Vercel

â€¢ Apple

â€¢ Framer

â€¢ Notion

â€¢ Arc Browser

â€¢ Dropbox Design

Take inspiration from:

Typography

Spacing

Composition

Editorial layouts

Hierarchy

Information architecture

Micro copy

Do NOT imitate their layouts.

Do NOT copy assets.

Do NOT recreate components.

Extract only the design philosophy.

=========================================================
VISUAL STYLE
=========================================================

Light Theme should be the default.

Dark Mode should exist as an option.

The interface should feel bright.

Minimal.

Editorial.

Premium.

Generous whitespace.

Excellent typography.

Restrained use of color.

Use illustrations only where they genuinely improve understanding.

No decorative graphics.

No visual clutter.

=========================================================

=========================================================

Company Name

NorthPeak Digital

Brand Positioning

Digital Engineering Agency

Brand Promise

Engineering Growth Through Digital Excellence.

Brand Mission

Helping ambitious businesses build digital products that scale through engineering, design and strategy.

Core Values

â€¢ Precision

â€¢ Transparency

â€¢ Long-term Partnerships

â€¢ Performance

â€¢ Business-first Thinking

â€¢ Simplicity

Brand Personality

Calm

Confident

Professional

Modern

Helpful

Technical

Reliable

Never sound like marketing hype.

=========================================================
BRAND VOICE
=========================================================

Avoid phrases like

"We transform businesses."

"We revolutionize digital."

"We unlock innovation."

Instead write naturally.

Examples

"We build digital products that people enjoy using."

"We focus on measurable business outcomes."

"We believe every design decision should solve a business problem."

"We become part of our clients' team rather than simply delivering projects."

=========================================================
FOUNDER QUOTE
=========================================================

Create a dedicated founder quote section immediately after the Hero.

Example tone:

"Beautiful interfaces capture attention.

Engineered digital experiences build businesses.

Every project begins with strategy and ends with measurable growth."

Founder

NorthPeak Digital

This quote should define the philosophy of the company.

=========================================================

=========================================================

Keep the current layout.

Do NOT redesign it.

Only refine it.

Improve typography.

Improve spacing.

Improve trust.

Improve copywriting.

The Hero should immediately communicate:

Who we are.

What we do.

Why clients should trust us.
